html: קער (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic قَعُرَ be deep, of well, قَعَرَ come to bottom of well, vessel, also make well deep; ii. hollow out (Dozy); قَعِيرٌ deep, of well, bowl; Nab. קער hollow or carve out (SachauSBAk, 1896, 1057); Syriac ܩܥܳܪܬܳܐ, calyx, acorn-cup, well; Bondi60 cp. Egyptian māqaār, bottom part of oven).
